{{Top|leg}}
A '''Maintenance Carrier''' was a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Three ships of the class, ''[[FarRun]]'', [[Fixer (Maintenance Carrier)|''Fixer'']], and ''[[Quartermain III]]'', were assigned to [[Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209/Legends|Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209]].
